title.en: An Act to Make An Additional Appropriation of Eighty thousand Pesos for the Campaign for the Eradication of Anthrax Under the Provisions of Act Numbered thirty-One Hundred and Nineteen, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
For the purpose of continuing and conducting the campaign for the eradication of anthrax in the
Philippine Islands, undertaken under the provisions of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and nineteen, the
sum of eighty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, to defray the necessary expense of the anthrax campaign. This sum shall be disbursed in the
manner and for the purposes provided for in said Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and nineteen.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
